---
title: "Identification of tissue specific genes & housekeeping genes"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Load library
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)
```
```{r}
# 1. Tissue specific genes
expr <- read.csv("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/07.tissue-specific/Dpse_mean_rpkm_8tissue.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
expr_filtered <- expr[rowMeans(expr) > 1, ]

## 1.Define tau
tau_index <- function(x) {
  if(max(x) == 0) return(0)
  1 - sum(x / max(x)) / (length(x) - 1)
}

## 2.Calculate tau for each gene
tau_scores <- apply(expr_filtered, 1, tau_index)

## 3.choose tau threshold(#0.75)
###1.Inspect the τ value distribution, If most genes have τ < 0.5 and a small peak is above 0.85 → threshold is reasonable.
hist(tau_scores, breaks = 50, col = "skyblue",
     main = "Distribution of Tau values",
     xlab = "Tau")
abline(v = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9), col = "red", lty = 2)
```
```{r}
###2.Number of genes above different thresholds
thresholds <- seq(0.6, 0.9, by = 0.05)
gene_counts <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) sum(tau_scores > t))
gene_count_df <- data.frame(Threshold = thresholds, Num_Genes = gene_counts)
print(gene_count_df)
```
```{r}
###3.heatmap
tissue_max <- apply(expr_filtered, 1, function(x) colnames(expr_filtered)[which.max(x)])
top_genes <- names(sort(tau_scores, decreasing = TRUE)[1:100])
expr_top <- expr_filtered[top_genes, ]
pheatmap(expr_top, scale = "row", cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, show_rownames = FALSE,
         main = "Top 100 Tau Genes")
```
```{r}
## 4.Define tissue-specific genes
tau_threshold <- 0.8   # adjustable
tissue_specific_genes <- names(tau_scores[tau_scores > tau_threshold])
tissue_specific_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = tissue_specific_genes,
  Tau = tau_scores[tissue_specific_genes],
  Max_Tissue = tissue_max[tissue_specific_genes]
)
```

```{r}
## 5. Housekeeping genes
# Housekeeping = low tau, broadly expressed
tau_threshold_hk <- 0.2   # common cutoff (can be 0.2–0.3 depending on distribution)
housekeeping_genes <- names(tau_scores[tau_scores < tau_threshold_hk])
housekeeping_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = housekeeping_genes,
  Tau = tau_scores[housekeeping_genes],
  MeanExpr = rowMeans(expr_filtered[housekeeping_genes, ])
) %>% arrange(Tau)
```
